key.name: history-size
key.summary: Maximum number of unpinned items kept
key.description: Oldest unpinned items are dropped past this limit. Pinned items never expire.

key.name: hotkey
key.summary: Global shortcut that toggles the popup
key.description: Registered as a Cinnamon custom keybinding running "funes toggle".

key.name: paste-on-select
key.summary: Paste into the focused window after selecting an item
key.description: Synthesizes Ctrl+V via xdotool after copying the item.

key.name: remember-size
key.summary: Persist the popup size after resizing

key.name: max-item-bytes
key.summary: Ignore clipboard text larger than this many bytes

key.name: reown-clipboard
key.summary: Take clipboard ownership after each capture
key.description: Keeps copied text available after the source application exits.

key.name: ignore-regexes
key.summary: Clipboard text matching any of these regexes is not stored
